item.title: Eric Adams slams Mamdani over prostitution stance; questions religious values
item.description: Mayor Eric Adams has criticized his mayoral race rival, Zohran Mamdani, over his past support for decriminalizing prostitution. Adams questioned how Mamdani's stance aligns with his Muslim faith, given Islam's prohibition of prostitution. Adams argues decriminalization would fuel sex trafficking and endanger vulnerable women, while Mamdani's campaign defends his record by highlighting Adams' budget cuts to victim services.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'More than happy': Sadiq Khan expresses willingness to meet Trump; London mayor unshaken by US leader's 'nasty person' jibe
item.description: Despite past clashes and strong disagreements on various issues, London Mayor Sadiq Khan has expressed his willingness to meet with US President Donald Trump. Khan criticized Trump's views on minorities and warned that his rhetoric could inadvertently radicalize individuals. He hopes to showcase London's diversity as a strength during Trump's potential visit, emphasizing inclusivity and understanding.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Game-changing': Steve Witkoff lauds Trump for 'successful' Putin summit; proposes security guarantees for Ukraine
item.description: Despite failing to secure a ceasefire during the Alaska summit with Vladimir Putin, the White House achieved a significant breakthrough, according to Middle East Envoy Steve Witkoff. The agreement on "Article 5-like protections" for Ukraine is considered a game-changer. While no follow-up meeting was planned, discussions marked the first time the US has seen meaningful accommodation from Russia.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ukraine crisis: Lindsey Graham threatens Russia with terrorism label; demands return of kidnapped children
item.description: Senator Lindsey Graham is considering pushing for bipartisan legislation to designate Russia as a state sponsor of terrorism if they don't return Ukrainian children reportedly abducted during the war. Graham emphasizes that any peace agreement must include the return of these children, and failure to do so would warrant the designation, making Russia "radioactive.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: World record: Ukrainian's 'ghost' snipers kill Russian soldiers from 4 km; AI and drone-assisted rifle used
item.description: A Ukrainian sniper team has reportedly achieved a new world record, eliminating two Russian soldiers from over 13,000 feet near Pokrovsk. The Kyiv Post reported the shot, made with a Ukrainian-made rifle and AI assistance, surpassed the previous record of 12,400 feet.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Putin will not stop': Ex-US VP calls for additional sanctions on Russia; applauds Trump
item.description: Former Vice President Mike Pence has urged President Trump to take a tougher stance against Russia, advocating for immediate and stronger sanctions on Vladimir Putin. Pence emphasized the need for decisive action, suggesting Trump should promptly push for the passage of a secondary sanctions bill supported by the Senate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Saudi Arabia caps foreign ownership in listed firms at 49%: Only six types of investors can qualify
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s Capital Market Authority has introduced sweeping reforms to regulate foreign investment in listed securities, capping total foreign ownership at 49% and individual non-resident stakes at 10%. Six specific investor categories are now eligible, with strategic investors exempt from the cap but subject to a two-year lock-in. The measures reflect a broader push to modernize and safeguard capital markets.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘One language, one voice’: Trump admin enforces English-only policy; Housing Dept removes translated material from website
item.description: HUD is implementing a new policy to make English the sole language for its services and operations, following President Trump's executive order. The directive instructs HUD leadership to immediately implement changes, removing non-English materials and halting translation services, except where legally required.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: NYC mayor elections: Anthony Weiner makes wild prediction on Zohran Mamdani — here’s what he said
item.description: Former Congressman Anthony Weiner predicts that Democratic leaders Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries will eventually endorse socialist mayoral nominee Zohran Mamdani, despite concerns about harming moderate candidates in the 2026 midterms. Weiner believes Mamdani is likely to win the mayoral race, dismissing the chances of independent candidates Eric Adams and Andrew Cuomo.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Putin unable to take Donetsk for 12 years': Zelenskyy's strong pitch on ceding territory day before Trump talks; 'need US on our side'
item.description: President Zelenskyy advocated against ceding territories to Russia ahead of talks with President Trump, emphasizing that territorial discussions require Ukraine's presence in a trilateral format. He stressed the need for a ceasefire and real negotiations along the current front line, seeking united Western backing.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Not off the table’: Marco Rubio leaves door open for Ukraine-Russia ceasefire; urges negotiations toward permanent peace
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated that a temporary ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia remains a possibility, despite stalled progress. Following President Trump's meeting with Vladimir Putin in Alaska, Rubio emphasized that Russia's agreement is crucial for any ceasefire. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stressed the urgency of a ceasefire to advance peace negotiations during discussions with European leaders.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump admin under fire: Over 300 protests sweep 44 states; Texas Democrats outraged over Republicans’ push to redraw maps
item.description: Across the United States, pro-democracy activists and labor organizations rallied against the Trump administration's support for Texas's Republican-favored redistricting plan. Texas Democrats, who fled to Illinois to block the plan, prompted Governor Abbott to call a second special session.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: NYC restaurant mass shooting: At least 3 dead, 8 injured as multiple gunmen open fire; probe on
item.description: In a tragic incident in Brooklyn's Crown Heights, three individuals lost their lives and eight others sustained injuries after multiple gunmen unleashed gunfire inside a restaurant early Sunday morning. Responding to the scene, authorities discovered at least 36 shell casings, initiating an ongoing investigation to identify and apprehend the suspects.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Oman: Six Asian men arrested with over 32kg of crystal meth, 23kg of marijuana
item.description: Oman's anti-narcotics directorate has apprehended six Asian nationals for possessing over 55kg of illegal drugs. The seized substances included 32kg of crystal meth and 23kg of marijuana. These arrests are part of Oman's intensified efforts to combat drug trafficking and protect public health, with legal procedures now underway for the suspects.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A camel for Cristiano Ronaldo? Saudi journalist marks footballer’s engagement with unique gift
item.description: Saudi journalist Ibrahim Al Faryan gifted Cristiano Ronaldo a camel to celebrate his engagement to Georgina Rodríguez, continuing his tradition of headline-making gestures. Known for presenting a Rolex to Fabinho in 2023, Al Faryan blends cultural symbolism with football celebrity. The gesture highlights his prominent role in Saudi sports media and the country’s growing football spotlight.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Zelenskyy-Trump meet: EU leaders to join Ukrainian president to support Kyiv cause - list includes Meloni, Macron among others
item.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy will meet Donald Trump with European leaders and Nato. Ursula von der Leyen and Giorgia Meloni will join him at the White House. Emmanuel Macron, Friedrich Merz, Mark Rutte, and Keir Starmer will also be present. This aims to prevent a US-Russia deal against Ukraine. It follows Trump's meeting with Vladimir Putin, excluding Zelenskyy.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Magic Johnson’s wife Cookie Johnson celebrates the Los Angeles Lakers legend’s 66th birthday at world famous chef’s restaurant
item.description: Magic Johnson celebrated his 66th birthday with an intimate dinner at Spago, hosted by his wife, Cookie Johnson. The couple shared joyous moments on Instagram, showcasing their enduring 33-year marriage. Cookie's heartfelt tribute highlighted their journey from college sweethearts to a power couple, admired for their resilience and individual successes in business and philanthropy.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Kuwait rolls out strict new health rules: Bans tattoo devices, razor reuse, and tanning for minors
item.description: Kuwait has new rules for salons and gyms. Tattoo devices are now banned. Sharing razors is not allowed. Minors cannot use tanning services. Workers need health certificates. They must remove jewellery during work. Salons must use approved products. Sterilization is a must. A committee will check if everyone follows the rules. Penalties will be given for violations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bahrain announces new 2025–26 academic calendar: Key dates every parent should know
item.description: Bahrain's Ministry of Education has announced the 2025-26 academic calendar, outlining key dates for public schools and continuing education. The school year commences with staff returning on September 1, 2025, followed by students on September 3, 2025. The calendar includes term dates, exam schedules, holiday breaks, and registration periods, providing a structured framework for the academic year.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: UAE: What are Certificates of Origin and how Abu Dhabi’s 10.3% rise proves a shift from oil dependence
item.description: The Abu Dhabi Chamber reported a 10.3% rise in Certificates of Origin issuance, reflecting the emirate’s expanding non-oil exports and growing industrial base. This trend highlights stronger SME participation, improved trade facilitation, and deepening global market integration. Officials view it as a key indicator of economic diversification and confidence in Abu Dhabi’s export quality and competitiveness.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
